overview.purpose: End-to-end demonstration of activity history visualization
overview.dataFlow: OpenCode CLI (devbob) → SurrealDB → RPC API (Redis cache-aside) → Dashboard UI

components.currentBehavior: Records activity execution locally in Activity.Info storage, calls MetabobCLI.recordActivityOutcome() for metrics
components.desiredBehavior: Should persist activity execution to SurrealDB activity_executions table via RPC API /activity/record endpoint
components.gap: MISSING: Direct SurrealDB persistence. Currently only records to metabob-cli backend (NOT the same as RPC API). Need to add HTTP call to RPC API /activity/record endpoint after activity completion.

components.currentBehavior: Inserts activity execution records into SurrealDB activity_executions table with full metrics (tokens, cost, duration, success status)
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Writes to SurrealDB as primary storage, no Redis write on insert (cache-aside on reads only)

components.currentBehavior: Implements cache-aside pattern: checks Redis cache first, on miss queries SurrealDB, populates cache with 60s TTL, returns formatted activity events
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Read path with Redis caching for <5ms latency
components.gap: PARTIAL: Actor attribution hardcoded to 'system@metabob.local'. Need to join with users table or add user_id field to activity_executions table.

components.currentBehavior: Protected endpoint requiring JWT authentication, calls get_organization_activity() with Redis client, returns paginated activity list
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - API endpoint with authentication and caching

components.currentBehavior: Defines SCHEMAFULL table with fields: execution_id, session_id, activity_id, variant_id, project_id, user_id, org_id, status, timestamps, duration, cost, tokens
components.desiredBehavior: MISMATCH - The schema defines execution_id, variant_id fields but insert_execution() uses activity_id, template_id. Schema needs alignment with actual usage.
components.gap: CRITICAL: Schema mismatch between migration (execution_id, variant_id) and actual code (activity_id, template_id). Need to update schema or update code to match.

components.currentBehavior: Deploys React dashboard with env vars REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL='', REACT_APP_AUTH_BASE_URL='/auth', routes API calls via Istio service mesh
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Dashboard deployed with correct API routing

components.currentBehavior: Defines release order: config → redis → surrealdb → metabob-rpc-api → metabob-dashboard → devbob, supports multiple environments (default/integration/production)
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Correct dependency chain and deployment order
components.gap: NONE - Helmfile correctly orchestrates all services

components.currentBehavior: Configures OpenCode server with SurrealDB connection (host: surrealdb, port: 8000, namespace: metabob, database: devbob)
components.desiredBehavior: IMPLEMENTED - Devbob can connect to SurrealDB
components.gap: MISSING: No RPC API URL configured. Devbob needs REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL or similar env var to know where to POST activity execution data.

components.currentBehavior: 15-step validation harness covering infrastructure (kubectx, pods, services), DNS, authentication, API validation, and integration
components.gap: PARTIAL: Steps 9-15 are placeholder/SKIP status. Need Playwright automation for browser-based validation (dashboard refresh, detail page, filtering).

transform.action: Calculates activity stats (tokens, cost, duration, success)
Sends activity execution data to RPC API
transform.currentStatus: MISSING - This HTTP call does not exist in OpenCode CLI

transform.action: Frontend timer triggers API request with JWT token
transform.output: HTTP GET request to RPC API
transform.currentStatus: ASSUMED - Dashboard code not traced in this analysis

transform.output: Cache HIT: Return cached data (<5ms), Cache MISS: Continue to step 6

transform.action: SELECT * FROM activity_executions ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT $limit
Converts execution records to activity event format (type, actor, timestamp, description, metadata)
Displays activity timeline with cards showing template, status, actor, duration, cost
transform.output: UI updated with latest activity data

validate.action: Browser automation: check for activity card in timeline

dataFlow.exit: Dashboard UI displays activity history, user can click to see detail page

criticalGaps.gap: OpenCode CLI does NOT persist to SurrealDB via RPC API
criticalGaps.impact: Activities executed in devbob are not visible in dashboard
criticalGaps.solution: Add HTTP POST to RPC API /activity/record endpoint in Activity.finalize()

criticalGaps.gap: SurrealDB schema mismatch (execution_id vs activity_id, variant_id vs template_id)
criticalGaps.impact: Schema migrations may fail or inserts may be rejected
criticalGaps.solution: Update schema to match actual field names used in code

criticalGaps.impact: Dashboard shows wrong user for all activities
criticalGaps.solution: Add user_id to activity_executions insert, join with users table in query

criticalGaps.gap: Devbob chart missing RPC API URL configuration
criticalGaps.impact: Even if OpenCode adds HTTP call, it won't know where to send data
criticalGaps.solution: Add METABOB_RPC_API_URL env var to devbob values

blockers: OpenCode CLI missing HTTP POST to RPC API /activity/record
SurrealDB schema needs field name updates
Devbob container needs RPC API URL environment variable
